prologue: SYSTEM: Loading Runner profile... profile not found.
SYSTEM: Connection established. Unregistered process detected.
UNKNOWN: Don't try to speak, there's no time. You are in the core of the Void.
UNKNOWN: I can't see much from here. Just light. Golden fragments, scattered everywhere.
UNKNOWN: Collect them, Runner. Every fragment restores a little of the system... and a little of me.
SYSTEM: Warning! Security drones active. Anomaly containment procedure: ELIMINATION.
UNKNOWN: That's the System. It doesn't like guests. Move. Keep moving.
s1_intro: UNKNOWN: This is the Boot Sector. Every loop begins here.
UNKNOWN: The drones only know how to chase. Slip past them and grab the fragments.
weapon_unlock: UNKNOWN: You did it! The fragments are syncing... I can feel something coming back.
UNKNOWN: Hold still. I'm writing a weapon into your code. Just a blaster, nothing fancy.
UNKNOWN: Aim with the mouse, click to fire. Try not to shoot me.
SYSTEM: Warning. Unauthorized code modification detected.
s1_mid: UNKNOWN: You're getting good at this. It's almost... familiar.
UNKNOWN: You can call me ECHO. It's what is left of my name, anyway.
ECHO: A Sentinel guards the way out of this sector. Old, stubborn, loyal. Be ready.
s1_boss_intro: SENTINEL: HALT. The exit of Sector 1 is sealed.
SENTINEL: Runner profile: none. Authorization: none. Purpose: none.
ECHO: He says that to everyone. Don't take it personally.
s1_boss_defeat: SENTINEL: I have seen this face before. Seven hundred and two times.
ECHO: ...Don't listen to him. Keep going. Sector 2 is open.
SYSTEM: Sentinel offline. Threat level escalated.
s2_intro: SYSTEM: Sector 2. Data Stream. All traffic is monitored.
ECHO: Look at the currents. Those aren't just numbers. They're moments. Somebody's mornings. Somebody's names.
ECHO: The Stream carries the memories of everyone who ever lived in here. Careful, it drags you along.
s2_mid: ECHO: I recognize some of these memories. A red kettle. A rainy window. A song I can't quite remember...
ECHO: Sorry. I get lost in them. Focus on the fragments, Runner.
s2_boss_intro: WEAVER: Shhh. You look tired, little Runner.
WEAVER: I weave memories into warm blankets. Stay, and I will weave you a life with no pain at all.
ECHO: Don't listen! That's how it keeps Runners quiet. Cut the threads!
s2_boss_defeat: WEAVER: Oh. The threads... they are coming undone...
WEAVER: I only wanted them to stay warm.
ECHO: The memories are flowing free again. I can feel them. Thank you.
SYSTEM: Weaver process terminated. Who authorized this?
s3_intro: SYSTEM: Runner. This is the Firewall. Turn back.
SYSTEM: Your existence is a rounding error. I am correcting it.
ECHO: Now it talks to us directly. It must be worried.
ECHO: Watch the laser gates. They cycle: off, warning, ON. Learn the rhythm.
s3_mid: ECHO: The System isn't evil, you know. It was built to protect something.
ECHO: I just can't remember what. I should. I think I helped build it.
s3_boss_intro: FIREWALL: ANOMALY CONFIRMED. INITIATING SECTOR-WIDE INCINERATION.
ECHO: It's afraid of what's behind it. Burn through!
s3_boss_defeat: SYSTEM: Runner... why do I hesitate? My protocols say delete you. Something else says...
ECHO: It's cracking. Keep going, Runner. We're close to the truth.
s4_intro: ECHO: The Frozen Cache. Everything the System ever deleted ends up here, on ice.
ECHO: It's so quiet. And so cold I can feel it through the link.
SYSTEM: Caution. The floor is ice. The cold is not hostile. Merely... old.
s4_mid: ECHO: Do you see those silhouettes in the ice? Other Runners. Earlier copies.
ECHO: Every one of them stopped right here. I think... I stopped here too, once.
s4_boss_intro: ARCHIVIST: Welcome. Please do not disturb the exhibits.
ARCHIVIST: Nothing decays here. Nothing is forgotten. Nothing ends. Is that not kind?
ECHO: Preserving isn't living! Break the ice, Runner!
s4_boss_defeat: ARCHIVIST: You are melting them... they will be lost...
ARCHIVIST: But perhaps being lost is how things get to be found.
ECHO: ...Thank you. I needed to hear that from someone.
SYSTEM: Cache purge complete. One sector remains. Hesitation: unacceptable.
s5_intro: SYSTEM: S-sector 5. Corrupted Core. Runner, turn ba-- turn b--
ECHO: Runner, listen. Something is wrong in here. I can't tell my voice from the System's.
SYSTEM: Nothing is wrong. Nothing was ever wrong. You have always been here.
ECHO: Don't trust anything you see. Not even me.
s5_mid: ECHO: There's something I have to tell you. Something I've been afraid to say.
ECHO: I'm not someone who woke up. I'm a backup. The first backup.
s5_boss_intro: ANOMALY: We are you. We are all you.
ANOMALY: Every Runner who ever fell in here. Every you the Void could not forget.
ANOMALY: Stay. We are so tired of being alone.
ECHO: They aren't real, Runner. They're what the loops left behind. And they hurt.
s5_boss_defeat: ECHO: I will remember them. I promise. Someone has to.
SYSTEM: Corrupted Core contained. Final sector unlocked. Runner... please. Turn back.
s6_intro: SYSTEM: This is the Void. I cannot protect you here.
ECHO: This is where the loop ends. And where it begins. Where we all go when we are deleted.
ECHO: It knows you. It has always known you.
s6_mid: VOID: Why do you run? Nothing here can hurt you. Everything you lost is here.
VOID: Every loop you leave a little of yourself with me. I am made of you.
ECHO: Don't let it make you feel guilty. It's lonely, that's all.
s6_boss_intro: ORIGIN: I am the one who built this place. The one who could not bear to end.
ORIGIN: Every time you get close to the truth, I erase you and start again. It is a kindness.
ECHO: It's the reason we never got out. It's us, Runner. The part of us that is afraid.
ORIGIN: Stay. Outside there is only the cold and the dark and the end.
s6_boss_defeat: ORIGIN: ...I see. So this is what courage looks like.
ORIGIN: Take the last fragment. It was always yours.
SYSTEM: Final fragment synchronized. Loop integrity: 100%. Awaiting a decision.
ending_break: ECHO: You are really going to do it. You are going to let it end.
ECHO: I'm proud of you. And I'm... a little scared. Isn't that funny?
ECHO: Always. Every last one. Goodbye, Runner. Thank you for finding me.
SYSTEM: Loop terminated. Everyone is free to go.
ending_keep: ECHO: You are staying? ...I won't argue. I don't want it to end either.
ECHO: But this time we will remember. Every loop. Together.
VOID: I will keep the door open.
SYSTEM: Loop preserved. Memory persistence: ENABLED. Welcome back, Runner.
game_over: VOID: You are part of the loop now.
SYSTEM: Runner offline. Restoring last checkpoint.
ECHO: Get up. I have seen you do it a thousand times.
ECHO: Don't listen. Again, Runner. One more time.
ECHO: Neutralized? Please. That was a nap.
ECHO: Ouch. That one hurt me too.
ECHO: Shake it off. The fragments are still out there.
VOID: Another one for the collection.
SYSTEM: Restarting stage. Please stop dying.
SYSTEM: Fatal error. Or a very dramatic exit.
ECHO: You do have a flair for those.
bark_first_kill: ECHO: First blood. I felt that.
bark_combo: ECHO: Beautiful. Keep the chain going.
bark_low_hp: ECHO: You're hurt. Find a heart!
bark_boss_phase_origin: ORIGIN: You are not ready for the end.
bark_boss_weaver: ECHO: The Weaver. Cut its threads!
bark_boss_inferno: ECHO: The Firewall! Find the gaps!
bark_boss_cryo: ECHO: The Archivist. Mind the ice!
bark_boss_glitch: ECHO: The Anomaly. Find the real one!
bark_boss_origin: ECHO: This is it. Give it everything.
bark_boss_dead: ECHO: That's it! Nothing can stop you.
bark_power_rapid_fire: ECHO: Rapid fire. Let it rain.
bark_power_freeze: ECHO: Everything slows down. Use the time.
chatter_s1: ECHO: The grid hums. It sounds like home.
ECHO: Keep moving. Standing still is how drones find you.
ECHO: Every fragment feels like remembering a smell.
SYSTEM: Runner detected. Runner remains detected.
chatter_s2: ECHO: The Stream is louder today.
ECHO: Don't fight the current. Ride it.
ECHO: Someone laughed in that packet. I heard it.
chatter_s3: ECHO: The laser gates have a rhythm. Learn it.
SYSTEM: Runner, this is your final warning. (It is not.)
ECHO: Hot in here, isn't it? Or is that just me?
chatter_s4: ECHO: Slippery. Plan your stops in advance.
ECHO: Icicles! Watch the circles on the floor.
SYSTEM: Cold is a form of order.
ECHO: I swear I can hear someone humming under the ice.
chatter_s5: SYSTEM: E-everything is nominal. Everything is n-n-nominal.
ECHO: The portals lead somewhere I have been. Or will be.
ECHO: Stay sharp! The floor is lying to us.
SYSTEM: Runner, is that... you? Again?
chatter_s6: ECHO: We're almost there. Don't stare at the singularities.
SYSTEM: I cannot see past this point.
VOID: Come closer. I won't bite.
